videoAnalyses.title: Box and Flow Techniques #2
videoAnalyses.summary: This video provides a 15-minute introductory class on boxing techniques, covering fundamental stances, basic punches, and defensive moves. Instructor Dani from Box + Flow breaks down the jab, cross, uppercuts, and hooks, before combining them into practical sequences to prepare viewers for a full boxing workout.

keyMoments.description: Explanation of the fundamental boxing stance and hand positioning.
Demonstration of the jab, focusing on reach and twisting the hand.
Demonstration of the cross, emphasizing power generation from the lower body and pivoting.
Demonstration of front and back uppercuts, highlighting the pivot and upward motion.
Demonstration of front and back hooks, focusing on the 90-degree elbow and body rotation.
Introduction to the slip, a defensive move to dodge straight punches.
Introduction to the weave, a defensive move involving a U-shaped motion.
First combination practice integrating the jab, cross, and uppercuts.

curriculum.targetTransformation: Throw punches that land. Build a fighter's body.

lessons.title: Throw your first four punches with correct form and full extension
lessons.summary: Learners establish the boxing stance and drill the jab, cross, uppercuts, and hooks with proper mechanics before combining jab and cross into their first sequence.

sessions.title: Stance, Jab, Cross, Uppercuts, and Hooks — Your First Four Punches
sessions.summary: Instructor Dani breaks down the fundamental boxing stance and walks through all four core punches — jab, cross, uppercuts, and hooks — finishing with jab-cross combinations.

steps.title: Drill the boxing stance and jab until the return position feels automatic
Reflect on what your first jab-cross combination revealed

clips.chapterTitle: Boxing Stance, Jab, Cross, and Jab-Cross Combination

lessons.title: Build the flow foundation that keeps your body open and mobile between rounds
lessons.summary: Learners move through the core yoga flow sequence — grounding breath, Cat/Cow, Downward Dog, high plank, low pushup, Up Dog, and Warrior 1 — developing the breath control and body awareness that powers the boxing work.

sessions.title: Grounding, Cat/Cow, Sun Salutation Flow, and Warrior 1
sessions.summary: Olivia Young guides learners from supine grounding breath through Cat/Cow, Downward Facing Dog, the full high-plank-to-Up-Dog-to-Down-Dog flow sequence, a standing fold and rise, and into Warrior 1 on both sides.

steps.title: Practice the high-plank-to-Up-Dog-to-Down-Dog flow sequence five times without stopping
Reflect on what the flow sequence demands from your body

clips.chapterTitle: Grounding Breath, Cat/Cow, Downward Dog, Sun Salutation Flow, Standing Fold, and Warrior 1

lessons.title: Dodge, counter, and string punches into your first real combinations
lessons.summary: Learners add the slip and weave defensive moves, then build two multi-punch combos — jab-cross-uppercut-uppercut and jab-cross-hook-hook — before finishing with a defense-integrated sequence: jab-cross-slip-cross.

sessions.title: Slip, Weave, and Three Punch Combinations Including Defense
sessions.summary: Dani introduces the slip and weave, then chains punches into practical combinations: jab-cross-up-up, jab-cross-hook-hook, and the defense-integrated jab-cross-slip-cross.

steps.title: Drill the jab-cross-slip-cross combination slowly, then at speed
Reflect on what happens to your form under combination pressure

clips.chapterTitle: Slip, Weave, Jab-Cross-Uppercut-Uppercut, Jab-Cross-Hook-Hook, and Jab-Cross-Slip-Cross

lessons.title: Open your hips and spine with Chair, Warrior 2, Side Angle, and Low Lunge Twist
lessons.summary: Learners extend the flow sequence with Chair pose, Warrior 2, Side Angle, and the Low Lunge Twist — building the hip mobility and spinal rotation a boxer's body needs to generate and absorb power.

sessions.title: Chair Pose, Warrior 2, Side Angle, Reverse Warrior, and Low Lunge Twist
sessions.summary: Olivia adds Chair pose into the Sun Salutation B variation, then flows through Warrior 2, Side Angle, Reverse Warrior, and the Low Lunge Twist on both sides.

steps.title: Hold Warrior 2 for five full breaths and feel where your 90-degree front knee wants to collapse
Reflect on how the Low Lunge Twist connects to your boxing rotation

clips.chapterTitle: Chair Pose, Warrior 2, Side Angle, Reverse Warrior, and Low Lunge Twist on Both Sides

lessons.title: Refine all four punches and both defensive moves with precision and full-body connection
lessons.summary: Olivia Young guides learners through a second pass of the complete boxing toolkit — stance, jab, cross, hook, uppercut, slip, and weave — with new coaching cues emphasizing malleability, full-body engagement, and clean defensive mechanics.

sessions.title: Stance, Jab, Cross, Hook, Uppercut, Slip, and Weave — Precision Refinement
sessions.summary: Olivia refines every punch and both defense moves with cues focused on dancer-like malleability, hip-driven power, correct elbow positioning, and upright defensive posture.

steps.title: Shadow-box with a focus on the hook's 90-degree arm and full-body pivot
Reflect on what 'malleability' means for your punching

clips.chapterTitle: Boxing Stance, Jab, Cross, Hook, Uppercut, Slip, and Weave — Refined Cues

lessons.title: Integrate speed, breath, and full punch combinations into a complete fighter's flow
lessons.summary: Learners synthesize everything — speed drills, exhale-on-every-punch breath control, and progressively longer combinations including jab-jab-cross and the full sequence — into a unified practice ready for a real Box and Flow class.

sessions.title: Speed Drills, Exhale Breathing, and Full Combination Sequences
sessions.summary: Olivia drills jab-cross at speed with hip movement, introduces exhale-on-every-punch breathing control, and builds through jab-cross, jab-jab-cross, and longer multi-punch combinations with precise focus on a single target.

steps.title: Run a full 3-minute combination round with audible exhales on every punch
Reflect on how breath and speed changed the quality of your combinations

clips.chapterTitle: Speed Drills, Exhale Breathing, and Full Combination Sequences Including Jab-Jab-Cross
